_comment: R2.4. Base-tier crafting: orb_basic and potion_small from gathered materials, at the campfire. CLAUDE.md: data that varies per recipe lives here, never in gameplay code.
_comment_scope: GAME_DESIGN.md 15 / MEADOWS_PROGRESSION_SPEC.md 10: baseline materials are wood, stone, fiber and berries and nothing else -- SD18 adds the Rootstone tier above these, later, in its own file rather than growing this one.
_comment_cost: `cost` is a list of {id, n} against autoload/inventory.gd, the same shape data/items/buildables.json already uses for build costs -- one format for 'what does this take'.
_comment_output: `output` is {id, n}: what one craft produces. Always one craft at a time; there is no bulk-craft multiplier here.
_comment_unlock: OF30. `unlocked_by` is an OPTIONAL autoload/progression_state.gd flag id. A recipe with no `unlocked_by` is known from the first minute (potion_small); a recipe that names one is not listed in the craft screen and cannot be crafted until that flag is set. Read through item_db.recipe_unlock_flag() and answered by game_state.recipe_known(). Deliberately a plain flag rather than a recipe-book system: the flag store already exists, already saves, and already loads, and a second parallel 'what do I know' list is the kind of speculative machinery CLAUDE.md's working-style section says not to build.
_comment_unlock_orb: The orb recipe is Tam the blacksmith's to hand over (OF30, owner: "Then he'll give you the recipe for basic orbs") -- his second conversation writes `recipe_orb_basic` and the craft screen gains a row. Grandpa's opening gift of fifteen orbs is untouched: the player has orbs from minute one, and what Tam adds is never running out of them again. TUNABLE, and cheap on purpose (spec: basic orbs are affordable) -- three wood and two fiber is one deadwood node and half a grass node.
